translation.name: El Nuevo Testament en el idioma Zapoteco de Loxicha

content: Beꞌ kub nde izyo kub
Xisa mbwiꞌn thi beꞌ kub nde thi izyo kub, tak beꞌ ner nde izyo ner mbluxa, nde taga' nittoꞌ.
Nde mbwiꞌn yez nayon, Jerusalén yez kub, ndela mbroꞌ lo beꞌ, tenꞌ ndob Dios. Jwinka ndokwaꞌy, xaja ndokwaꞌ thi mzaꞌ ta kayaꞌ tsalꞌ na.
Nde mbin na ne toz mni ti xa' lo beꞌ nchab xaꞌ: —Wiꞌ nea, liz Dios ndob xij re men naya. Yono Dios xaꞌ nde ak xaꞌ yez Dios, nde yub Dios tyono xaꞌ nde ak Dios, Dios xaꞌ.
Dios kwiꞌs nit mbe lo reta xaꞌ, nde naꞌyotra yalguj, neka winꞌ, nayotra yalnabil, nde naꞌyowtraꞌ xaꞌ, tak reta jwanꞌ ngo nera, mbriꞌd ley.
Zyasa Xaꞌ ta ndob lo yasil tenꞌ nyebeꞌ xaꞌ ya nchab: —Wiꞌ nea, na ndoxkwa nakub reta jwanꞌ. Nde ne xaꞌ: —Pkeꞌ jwanꞌ reꞌ lo yeꞌs, tak reta diꞌs reꞌ, galꞌ naka nde lipay.
Xisa negaꞌ Xaꞌ lon: —Se ngoka. Na nak xan' nde na nak lulka lo re jwan', ta xa nak letr A nde letr Z. Cho xaꞌ nchek, tata a tan nit ta ndobsiꞌb tenꞌ nchalꞌ nit ndaꞌ yalnaban gu xaꞌ.
Nde re xaꞌ li gan nalid jwan' narax, xaꞌ ya kayaꞌ reta jwanꞌ re', aka chanꞌ xaꞌ nde na ak Dios xaꞌ nde xaꞌ ak xinꞌ na.

Per re xaꞌ nazeb mbla' xki's na, re xaꞌ nandlid lazonꞌ na, re xaꞌ xkap, re xaꞌ guj men, re xaꞌ nchaxno xaꞌxaꞌ men, re xaꞌ mxí, re xaꞌ ndyoxub lo re mnab nde reta xaꞌ kwinꞌ, reta xaꞌ ya, ya tenꞌ nzi adiꞌ bel ndoyol kon azufre, jwanꞌ reꞌ nak yalguj brop.
Jerusalen yez kub
Nde thi anj jwanꞌ nzo xij re gaz anj jwanꞌ ta nden re gaz kop jwanꞌ nzo lulka re gaz yalti ya, mbyeꞌd lon nde ne: —Deꞌ sa loꞌn loa mzaꞌ jwanꞌ selyaꞌno Mbakxilꞌ yenꞌ, mzaꞌ ak salꞌ Mbakxilꞌ yenꞌ.
Nde kon yalne chan' Mbi Nayon, mbeꞌ anj na lo thi yek yiꞌ ro gap toz ndaꞌb, nde mbloꞌ anj lon yez ro, Jerusalen yez nayon ndalay mbroꞌy lo beꞌ tenꞌ ndob Dios.
Yez ya leꞌka ndlya bel nyay ndyob xni chanꞌ Dios lad neꞌy, xaja nya thi ke jwanꞌ ntak toz, xa nya thi ke jaspe, anta ndriꞌd xni nyay xaja bidra.
Dib ro yez ndo pto ro gap ndaꞌb, nde nge thibsen yalay, nde thiba ro yala ndo ti anj, nde lad thiba yala ya nge thiba le re thibsen xin' Israel.
Tson yala nge lad ned nched ke wiz, tsona nge lad ned nchaꞌd wis, tsona nge lad ban nde thi tsona nge lad beg.
Leꞌ xanꞌ pto jwanꞌ ndo nowꞌ yez nzo thibsen ke jwanꞌ nak xanꞌ neꞌy, nde lad tiba ke ya nge tiba le re thibsen apost chanꞌ Mbakxilꞌ yenꞌ.
Leꞌ anj jwanꞌ ndotodiꞌs lon nden thi bar naksaꞌ or sa chiꞌx anj yez, chiꞌx anj re yalan neꞌy nde dib pton neꞌy.
Nde kwadrad naksaꞌ yez, thita naxen naxa nde nolꞌla. Senꞌ mchiꞌx anj yez kon kos nden anj, chop mil nzo chop ayoꞌ kilómetro nol'la, yapa ndab gapa nde yapa naxen na.
Xisa mchiꞌx anj pto, thib ayoꞌ nzo choꞌ sij ndoy, nde medid jwanꞌ ndlirsinꞌ mena mbli rsin' anj.
Dib pto naksaꞌ ke jaspe, yez naksaꞌ tub or, xaja nya bidr nambi tira.
Re ke jwanꞌ naksaꞌ xanꞌ pto nawe ntokwaꞌ xaꞌy kon reta ned ke ntak toz. Ke ner nak jaspe, ke brop nak zafiro, ke byon nak ágata, ke thap nak esmeralda,
ke gayꞌ nak ónice, ke xop nak cornalina, ke gaz nak crisólito, ke xon nak berilo, ke yeꞌ nak topasio, ke siꞌ nak crisoprasa, ke tsiꞌbthib nak jasinto nde ke thibsen nak amatista.
Re thibsen yala naksaꞌ ke perla, thiba yala naksaꞌy thi ke perla. Nde leꞌ ned ro nzo lenꞌ yez naksaꞌy tub or, nde xaja nya bidr nyay ndrid xni.
Nde naꞌngwiꞌt na nek thib yodoꞌ lenꞌ yez, tak Xud na' Dios Xaꞌ ngeno dib yalnyebeꞌ, kon Mbakxilꞌ yenꞌ nak yodoꞌ lenꞌ ney.
Nanakinꞌtrey wiz toxni, nekla mbeꞌ, tak legaꞌ xnin Dios ntoxni lenꞌ neꞌy nde Mbakxilꞌ yenꞌ nak xnin neꞌy.
Nde reta ned men lo izyo jwanꞌ mtolaꞌ Dios, kete lo xnin neꞌy nde reta rey yano xaꞌ yalnaro chanꞌ xa' lo ne'y
Reta yalan yez ya ndoxalꞌ dib wiz, tak tya naꞌlyada yalꞌ.
Tya yano xaꞌ reta yalnaro nde jwanꞌ ntak chanꞌ reta ned men nzo lo izyo.
Per nek thib jwanꞌ bew naꞌyoteda lenꞌ neꞌy neka re xaꞌ jwanꞌ ndli re jwanꞌ xkap nde re xaꞌ kwinꞌ. Benꞌta re xaꞌ jwanꞌ nzo le na' lo libr chanꞌ yalnaban jwanꞌ nden Mbakxilꞌ yenꞌ yotey.
